text:
lia-peopleops: FYI — we have an incoming conversion for an intern (Samir) starting 6/1. There's a proposed comp package but manager flagged proration + sign-on clawback question. Need routing.

alex_k: TL;DR — manager wants full-time comp at L3 midpoint, 10% one-time sign-on, and a prorated RSU grant for the first year. Payroll flagged clawback on sign-on if leaves within 6 months.

sophie_p: Can we confirm Samir's current intern pay and any prior sign-on? Need to calculate proration against fiscal equity calendar.

jake_rm: Intern was on hourly contractor conversion tracks — paid through payroll. No prior sign-on. Hourly -> salary conversion note on file.

emily-peopleops: Attach the proposed offer compband: band L3, base $135k, sign-on $13.5k (10%), RSU 2000 shares vests quarterly after 1 year cliff. Is that what manager sent?

lia-peopleops: yes that's the manager proposal. They also asked if we can backdate benefits eligibility to 6/1 if offer accepted now.

talent-ops: Benefits eligibility typically kicks at first day of FT employment. We can request early enrollment but needs payroll setup + benefits vendor OK.

payroll-bot: payroll note: to prorate pay and retro benefits, submit off-cycle enrollment request. Deadline to hit 6/1 processing is COB next Fri.

alex_k: Two questions for approvers: 1) Approve L3 midpoint base? 2) Approve one-time sign-on with 6-month clawback?

emily-peopleops: I can route for comp approval but we need written manager justification for above-midpoint / sign-on. Also is this within the conversion OTE banding policy?

lia-peopleops: Manager justification pasted: "exception because candidate has unique infra experience, recruiting loss risk high, pipeline time >3 months."

sophie_p: OK. I'll start the approval routing. Routing path: hiring manager -> recruiting lead -> finance-ops -> people-ops committee (for exceptions) -> legal if unusual clauses.

finance-ops: Can we get a quick cost calc: annualized base + sign-on amortized over 12 months = $135k + $13.5k apportioned. Also need to check headcount budget code. I'll flag if >10% over band baseline.

lia-peopleops: One more policy question: do we allow sign-on clawback less than 12 months for intern conversions? Older guidance suggests 12 months minimum for new hires, but we have flexibility for early conversions.

legal-bot: legal note: clawback clause must be explicit in offer and meet local labor law. In some EU regions 6-month clawbacks are enforceability-risky. Recommend 12 months for international hires.

alex_k: Candidate is US-based, Seattle. 6-month clawback probably enforceable but risk-tolerant. Manager prefers 6 months.

emily-peopleops: Filing: I'll submit comp exception packet now with manager justification, budget sign-off pending, and request 6-month clawback language for legal to review.

lia-peopleops: Payroll timeline reminder — need accepted offer + signed documents by EOD Thu to hit benefit start 6/1. Otherwise benefit start will be next month.

jake_rm: I'll confirm candidate's acceptance ETA. He said after final comp email.

talent-ops: Routing started. cc @finance-ops @legal-bot. Will post updates here. :thumbsup:

finance-ops: Quick reply — budget OK if we accept 10% sign-on but need to mark as hiring premium. Approve routing to people-ops committee.

legal-bot: Received packet. Drafting 6-month clawback language, will advise on enforceability.

emily-peopleops: Committee scheduled in 2 hours. If approved, I'll send offer template with clawback and prorated equity lines.

lia-peopleops: Great. Please keep slack thread notes minimal — will archive once offer accepted. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
